summary: Comprehensive production upgrade implementation plan for SYNTHOS: clinical pharmacometrics digital twin and decision support matrix. Covers deterministic PK engine extension (bolus, infusion, oral, Michaelis-Menten, two-compartment), transparent triage scoring matrix, versioned drugs database (7 core + 300+ directory), Gemini AI server-side explanation with strict JSON schema and streaming fallback, PHI-blocking input sanitizer, Firebase Auth + custom claims RBAC, Firestore security rules and DPDP Act 2023 compliance, pastel design system tokens (#FBF9FF, #CDB4DB, #7C6BC4, etc.), guided 3-step simulation wizard, automated unit test suite, and pre-launch audit.
